parameters.jsCode: const doc=$json;const binary=$binary?.anexo_arquivo;if(!binary)throw new Error('Downloaded PDF binary anexo_arquivo is missing');const fileName=binary.fileName||'';if(!/\.pdf$/i.test(fileName))throw new Error(`Only PDF files can enter the approval queue: ${fileName||'unknown file'}`);const title=String(doc.title||fileName).trim();const text=`${doc.date||''} ${doc.desc||''} ${title}`;let isoDate=null;const iso=text.match(/\b(20\d{2})[-/.](\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{1,2})\b/);const numeric=text.match(/\b(\d{1,2})[/.](\d{1,2})[/.](\d{4})\b/);const months=text.match(/\b(\d{1,2})[\s/_-](jan|fev|mar|abr|mai|jun|jul|ago|set|out|nov|dez)[a-z]*[\s/_-](\d{4})\b/i);if(iso)isoDate=`${iso[1]}-${iso[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${iso[3].padStart(2,'0')}`;else if(numeric)isoDate=`${numeric[3]}-${numeric[2].padStart(2,'0')}-${numeric[1].padStart(2,'0')}`;else if(months){const month={jan:'01',fev:'02',mar:'03',abr:'04',mai:'05',jun:'06',jul:'07',ago:'08',set:'09',out:'10',nov:'11',dez:'12'}[months[2].toLowerCase().slice(0,3)];isoDate=`${months[3]}-${month}-${months[1].padStart(2,'0')}`;}const parsed=isoDate&&new Date(`${isoDate}T00:00:00Z`);if(!parsed||Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())||parsed.toISOString().slice(0,10)!==isoDate)throw new Error(`Could not determine a valid ISO publication date for ${title}`);const identity=title.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/\.pdf$/i,'').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'');if(!identity)throw new Error(`Could not derive a stable document identity for ${title}`);const documentId=`${identity}-${isoDate}`;return {json:{title,date:isoDate,url:String(doc.href||''),document_id:documentId,file_path:`/home/ubuntu/nfe-pdf-cache/${documentId}.pdf`},binary:{anexo_arquivo:binary}};

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json.body&&typeof $json.body==='object'?$json.body:$json;const id=$('Validar Payload Hermes').first().json.batch_id;const b=Array.isArray(r.batches)?r.batches.find(x=>x.batch_id===id&&x.status==='approved'):null;if(r.ok!==true||!b||!Array.isArray(b.items)||!b.items.length)return [{json:{valid:false,code:'BATCH_NOT_APPROVED',message:'Daemon did not confirm this batch as approved'}}];const steps=['email','google_drive','notebooklm'];const states=steps.flatMap(s=>b.items.map(i=>i.delivery?.[s]||'not_started'));if(states.some(s=>s!=='not_started'))return [{json:{valid:false,code:'DELIVERY_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION',message:'Distribution already started; do not replay external effects'}}];return [{json:{valid:true,batch_id:b.batch_id,items:b.items}}];

parameters.jsCode: const inputs=$input.all();const sourceItems=$('Restaurar IDs do Google Drive').all();if(!inputs.length)throw new Error('NotebookLM returned no synchronization results');const failed=[];const messages=[];for(let index=0;index<inputs.length;index++){const item=inputs[index],raw=item.json||{};const pair=Array.isArray(item.pairedItem)?item.pairedItem[0]?.item:item.pairedItem?.item;const source=sourceItems[Number.isInteger(pair)?pair:index]?.json||{};const body=raw.body&&typeof raw.body==='object'?raw.body:(raw.error?.response?.body||raw.error?.body||raw);const detail=typeof body.error==='string'?body.error:(raw.error?.message||raw.message||JSON.stringify(body.error||body));const isFailure=Boolean(raw.error)||body.status==='error'||Number(raw.statusCode||body.statusCode)>=400;if(isFailure){const title=String(body.title||raw.title||source.document_title||'Documento sem t?tulo').trim();const drive_file_id=body.drive_file_id||raw.drive_file_id||source.drive_file_id;failed.push({title,drive_file_id});messages.push(`${title}: ${String(detail||'NotebookLM returned an error').replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,400)}`);}}if(!failed.length)return [{json:{success:true,batch_id:$('Validar Lote Aprovado').first().json.batch_id}}];const unique=[];const seen=new Set();for(const item of failed){const key=`${item.title}::${item.drive_file_id||''}`;if(!seen.has(key)){seen.add(key);unique.push(item);}}return [{json:{batch_id:$('Validar Lote Aprovado').first().json.batch_id,action:'record_step',step:'notebooklm',outcome:'uncertain',failure:{items:unique,message:[...new Set(messages)].join(' | ').slice(0,2000)}}}];
